headline: GIC Re appoints two bank EDs as non-exec directors
summary: General Insurance Corporation of India appointed S K Majumdar and Pramod Kumar Dwibedi as Non-Executive Directors. Both are Executive Directors at Canara Bank and Bank of India respectively.

headline: Dilip Buildcon wins ₹419.47 crore Gurgaon metro order
summary: Dilip Buildcon received a ₹419.47 crore Letter of Acceptance from Gurugram Metro Rail Limited for a depot-cum-workshop project with a 21-month completion period.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Oriana Power, Ashoka Buildcon, Coal India in focus
summary: Oriana Power rallies on Gobardhan approvals while Ashoka Buildcon faces Saudi project cancellation. Coal India files RHP for Mahanadi IPO as Dilip Buildcon secures metro orders.

headline: Prestige Estates launches ₹5,500 mn North Bengaluru project
summary: Prestige Estates Projects Limited launched Prestige Avon in North Bengaluru with a GDV of ₹5,500 million. The 3-acre residential project comprises 260 apartments.
